Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production sprite animation sheet on TRUE TRANSPARENT background, 2048x2048 square, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows of equal 512 square cells. No text, gridlines, scenery, shadows or labels. Each cell contains one complete full-body painted sprite, with generous empty margins; nothing crosses a cell boundary. Canonical identity references attached in row order: row 1 Reaver (closed steel helmet, battered plate and long torn RED cape), row 2 Starseer (dark blue hood and torn star-patterned robe, brass scroll tubes), row 3 Herald (rust-red hood, brown clerical tattered robes, gold cross embroidery and belt book), row 4 Rogue (brown hood leather armor and torn dark TEAL cape). These are identity/style references, not edit targets. Preserve their realistic painterly dark-fantasy style and correct anatomy. All face right away from viewer, rear three-quarter view, back dominant, opponent offscreen right. Do not show frontal faces. Every row is a distinct FOUR-FRAME attack with that same character and same specified weapon: columns anticipation, strike/release, follow-through, recovery. Paint truly different limb/body poses, no mere translated or rotated duplicates. Two arms and two legs each, natural joints, grounded boots. Approximately 330 pixel standing body height per cell with foot baseline y=465 within each cell. Consistent body scale, fixed camera. Weapons may use remaining margin but must fit fully. Maintain recognizable costume in every frame. Hide non-used original held weapons; preserve outfit accessories. No other characters. Weapon and hands must contact correctly.
WEAPON FAMILY: GREAT SWORD. One large straight steel greatsword, long two-handed grip, BOTH gauntleted hands firmly on hilt, no shield. Four frames: sword loaded high behind right shoulder with bent knees; powerful two-handed diagonal cut extending toward right; low forward follow-through with rotated shoulders; controlled return to two-handed ready guard. Keep blades entirely in cell.
